raster.sampleWindow: 3x3 pixel neighborhood around the approximate Perseverance sol-400 location

nearbyCoverage.note: A nearby valid sample is not substituted for the specified rover coordinate in any site-level interpretation.

limitations: CRISM pixel is approximately 18 m while the rover coordinate is approximate; the 3x3 window is spatial context, not an exact rover-footprint match.
The selected 3x3 window at the rover coordinate is entirely no-data in the cube; no CRISM spectrum is reported for that coordinate.
Spectrum is a mean/median of corrected I/F in a local 3x3 window; no mineral identification or spectral unmixing is performed.
The 489 spectral samples come from one targeted observation and are not directly comparable to Sentinel-2 reflectance values.
